proved_reduction.statement: Any finite hill arrangement and any finite set of its counted bounded triangular faces can be projectively transformed to an affine arrangement with no parallel line pairs while preserving all selected counted bounded triangular faces.

remaining_gap.issue: The source-scoped charging/fan extraction is not yet independently proved by GCL. Conditional on those premises, all profile-3334 four-core states are excluded; the four-core score-95 residual is profile 3333 only, and all q>=5 cases remain open.
remaining_gap.target: Resolve q=4 profile 3333 next, then derive q>=5 aggregate constraints; independently prove required geometric premises where possible, or construct/replay 95.

claim_boundary: H1-12 is strictly narrowed, not closed. Conditional on the named source-scoped premises, q<=3 is excluded and the q=4 score-95 residual is reduced to profile 3333 only; q>=5 remains open. No hill-global <=94, optimality, or MATHCERT claim.

source_conditional_reduction.statement: Conditional on the protected clean-line charging, endpoint-capacity, and local fan premises, an n=18,T=95 normalized arrangement cannot have exactly three finite multiple points. Hence any such witness must have at least four finite multiple points.
source_conditional_reduction.arithmetic_effect: The q=3 arithmetic leaves a unique saturated three-triple template; the proof note then excludes that template using the endpoint-level clean-line charge map and local fan geometry.

four_core_reduction.statement: Conditional on the stated defect/fan premises, an n=18,T=95 normalized arrangement with exactly four finite multiple points has multiplicities only 3333, 3334, 3335, 3344, or 3444. Adding the named clean-line/local refinements forces minimum D2 values 1, 3, 6, 5, and 6 respectively.

saturated_core_reduction.statement: Conditional on the named local no-long-run fan premise, a convex-hull vertex (extreme core) cannot be saturated. For four noncollinear cores with D2>=5, at least three cores are extreme, so at most one core may be saturated. The protected q=4 finite replay then excludes profiles 3335, 3344, and 3444, leaving only 3333 and 3334.
saturated_core_reduction.independent_component: extreme-point half-plane argument and finite replay

profile_3334_normal_form.statement: The 67 saturated-core-filtered finite states with multiplicities 3334 collapse, modulo permutation of the three triple cores, to nine graph/role types: two D2=3 stars, one non-saturated D2=4 cycle, three D2=4 star-plus-outer-edge types, and three D2=5 K4-minus-outer-pair types.

profile_3334_normal_form.source_scoped_component: saturated hubs are non-extreme via the local no-long-run fan premise
